legend: Red is a Pokemon trainer who has beaten the Kanto Pokemon League, and wants to get to Johto for new challenges. To get there, he needs to travel by train.

The region has N$$$N$$$ train stations labelled from 1$$$1$$$ to N$$$N$$$. Ash starts at station 1$$$1$$$ and needs to get to station N$$$N$$$ to enter Johto. There are M$$$M$$$ bidirectional train lines, where the ith$$$i^{\text{th}}$$$ train line connects stations Xi$$$X_i$$$ and Yi$$$Y_i$$$, and multiple train lines may connect the same pair of cities. It is possible to get from city 1$$$1$$$ to city N$$$N$$$ with the train lines, but it may not be possible to get from city 1$$$1$$$ to some other cities with the train lines.

To use the ith$$$i^{\text{th}}$$$ train line, Red needs to pay Ci$$$C_i$$$ dollars for a lifetime pass, after which he may use the train line as many times as he wants. He can only purchase the pass for the ith$$$i^{\text{th}}$$$ train line when he is at station Xi$$$X_i$$$ or Yi$$$Y_i$$$, and he can only purchase it once.

The payment system is online, where Red only needs to make a delayed bulk payment for the passes he bought when he enters Johto (due to immigration policies). Note that when he reaches station N$$$N$$$, he does not need to pay yet, and can continue taking trains. He only pays when he exits station N$$$N$$$ and reaches the immigration counter.
Due to a bug in the system, he will only need to pay for the passes with the K$$$K$$$ smallest costs (or all of them if he bought fewer than K$$$K$$$ passes) when he reaches Johto.
Help Red determine the minimum amount of money (in dollars) he needs to spend to get from Kanto to Johto.
input: The first line of the input contains 3 integers N,M,K$$$N, M, K$$$ (2≤N≤105$$$2 \leq N \leq 10^5$$$, 1≤K≤M≤2⋅105$$$1 \leq K \leq M \leq 2 \cdot 10^5$$$).
The next M$$$M$$$ lines of the input each contain 3 integers Xi,Yi,Ci$$$X_i, Y_i, C_i$$$ (1≤Xi,Yi≤N$$$1 \leq X_i, Y_i \leq N$$$, Xi≠Yi$$$X_i \neq Y_i$$$, 1≤Ci≤109$$$1 \leq C_i \leq 10^9$$$).
It is guaranteed that Red can get from station 1$$$1$$$ to station N$$$N$$$ using the train lines.
output: Output a single integer, the minimum amount of money (in dollars) Red needs to spend to get from station 1 to station N$$$N$$$.
note: In the first sample, note that Red cannot buy the pass for the train line connecting stations 3$$$3$$$ and 6$$$6$$$, as there is no way to reach those cities by train.

To get to city N$$$N$$$, Red may buy the pass to travel between stations 1$$$1$$$ and 2$$$2$$$, travel to station 2$$$2$$$, buy the pass to travel between stations 2$$$2$$$ and 7$$$7$$$, travel to station 7$$$7$$$, buy the pass to travel between stations 7$$$7$$$ and 5$$$5$$$, travel to station 5$$$5$$$, buy the pass to travel between stations 5$$$5$$$ and 4$$$4$$$, travel back to station 7$$$7$$$ (note that he does not have to travel to station 4$$$4$$$ after buying the pass), then go to immigration.
The passes he buys cost 3,3,2,2$$$3, 3, 2, 2$$$ in that order, and he pays for the K=2$$$K = 2$$$ cheapest, for a cost of 2+2=4$$$2 + 2 = 4$$$. It can be shown this is the minimum possible.

In the second sample, Red may travel 1→2→6→4→7$$$1 \rightarrow 2 \rightarrow 6 \rightarrow 4 \rightarrow 7$$$, buying the passes between consecutive cities in the route, and pay 4+3+2+3=12$$$4 + 3 + 2 + 3 = 12$$$ as he only buys 4$$$4$$$ passes but K=5$$$K = 5$$$. It can be shown this is the minimum possible.

In the third sample, Red may buy all the passes, and he only pays for the K=2$$$K = 2$$$ passes between stations 1$$$1$$$ and 2$$$2$$$ which cost 1$$$1$$$ each, for a total cost of 1+1=2$$$1 + 1 = 2$$$.

legend.ai: Red 是一名宝可梦训练家，他已经战胜了关都宝可梦联盟，现在想前往城都迎接新的挑战。为了到达那里，他需要乘坐火车。

该地区有 N$$$N$$$ 个火车站，编号从 1$$$1$$$ 到 N$$$N$$$。Ash 从车站 1$$$1$$$ 出发，需要到达车站 N$$$N$$$ 才能进入城都。这里有 M$$$M$$$ 条双向铁路，其中第 ith$$$i^{\text{th}}$$$ 条铁路连接车站 Xi$$$X_i$$$ 和 Yi$$$Y_i$$$，并且同一对城市之间可能有多条铁路。通过这些铁路可以从城市 1$$$1$$$ 到达城市 N$$$N$$$，但可能无法通过这些铁路从城市 1$$$1$$$ 到达其他某些城市。
要使用第 ith$$$i^{\text{th}}$$$ 条铁路，Red 需要支付 Ci$$$C_i$$$ 美元购买永久通行证，之后他可以任意次使用该铁路。他只有在车站 Xi$$$X_i$$$ 或 Yi$$$Y_i$$$ 时才能购买第 ith$$$i^{\text{th}}$$$ 条铁路的通行证，并且每条铁路的通行证只能购买一次。
支付系统已经上线，Red 只需要在进入城都时(由于移民政策)为他购买的通行证进行一次延迟的大额付款。注意，当他到达车站 N$$$N$$$ 时，还不需要付款，并且可以继续乘坐列车。只有当他离开车站 N$$$N$$$ 并到达移民检查站时，他才需要付款。
由于系统中的一个漏洞，当 Red 到达城都时，他只需要为费用最小的 K$$$K$$$ 张通行证付款(如果他购买的通行证少于 K$$$K$$$ 张，则为所有通行证付款)。
请帮助 Red 确定他从关都前往城都所需支付的最少金额（单位：美元）。

input.ai: 输入的第一行包含 3 个整数 N、M、K$$$N, M, K$$$(2≤N≤105$$$2 \leq N \leq 10^5$$$，1≤K≤M≤2⋅105$$$1 \leq K \leq M \leq 2 \cdot 10^5$$$)。
接下来的 M$$$M$$$ 行中，每行包含 3 个整数 Xi、Yi、Ci$$$X_i, Y_i, C_i$$$(1≤Xi,Yi≤N$$$1 \leq X_i, Y_i \leq N$$$，Xi≠Yi$$$X_i \neq Y_i$$$，1≤Ci≤109$$$1 \leq C_i \leq 10^9$$$)。
保证 Red 可以使用这些铁路线路从车站 1$$$1$$$ 到达车站 N$$$N$$$。

output.ai: 输出一个整数，表示 Red 从车站 1 到车站 N$$$N$$$ 所需花费的最少金额(美元)。

note.ai: 在第一个样例中，请注意，Red 无法购买连接车站 3$$$3$$$ 和 6$$$6$$$ 的铁路线路通行证，因为没有办法乘坐火车到达这两座城市。

为了到达城市 N$$$N$$$，Red 可以购买车站 1$$$1$$$ 和 2$$$2$$$ 之间的通行证，前往车站 2$$$2$$$；购买车站 2$$$2$$$ 和 7$$$7$$$ 之间的通行证，前往车站 7$$$7$$$；购买车站 7$$$7$$$ 和 5$$$5$$$ 之间的通行证，前往车站 5$$$5$$$；购买车站 5$$$5$$$ 和 4$$$4$$$ 之间的通行证，然后返回车站 7$$$7$$$(注意，购买通行证后，他不必前往车站 4$$$4$$$)，最后前往移民局。
他按此顺序购买的通行证价格为 3、3、2、2$$$3, 3, 2, 2$$$，由于只需支付其中最便宜的 K=2$$$K = 2$$$ 张通行证的费用，因此总费用为 2+2=4$$$2 + 2 = 4$$$。可以证明这是可能的最小费用。

在第二个样例中，Red 可以按照 1→2→6→4→7$$$1 \rightarrow 2 \rightarrow 6 \rightarrow 4 \rightarrow 7$$$ 的路线行进，购买路线中相邻城市之间的通行证。由于他只购买了 4$$$4$$$ 张通行证，而 K=5$$$K = 5$$$，因此只需支付 4+3+2+3=12$$$4 + 3 + 2 + 3 = 12$$$。可以证明这是可能的最小费用。
在第三个样例中，Red 可以购买所有通行证，并且只需支付车站 1$$$1$$$ 和 2$$$2$$$ 之间的 K=2$$$K = 2$$$ 张通行证的费用，这些通行证每张价格为 1$$$1$$$，总费用为 1+1=2$$$1 + 1 = 2$$$。
